issue.title: Retire the pluggable finalizers beta and legacy controller
issue.description: Make host-owned pluggable finalization unconditional, remove the deprecated Off path and beta compatibility code, prove the complete protocol end to end, and close flag bead sase-ro only after the combined tree is green.

issue.title: Complete the finalizer protocol and parity harness
issue.description: harden-protocol: turn the original acceptance matrix into executable generic-controller coverage, finish any missing fixed-point, retry, stale-state, conflict, and outside-agent behavior, and leave the flag-On path green before retirement.

issue.title: Make pluggable finalizers unconditional and delete the old path
issue.description: retire-legacy: delete the pluggable_finalizers flag and Off branch, extract any still-needed reconciliation helpers from the deprecated controller, remove beta-only config, environment, baseline, metric, and artifact writers, and preserve only deliberate historical readers.

issue.title: Synchronize CLI, schema, docs, and generated skill source
issue.description: synchronize-contracts: describe unconditional finalization across configuration, workflows, CLI and xprompt docs, remove beta and legacy guidance, update the canonical sase_final skill source and snapshots, and preview generated runtime skills without deploying a dirty tree.

issue.title: Run adversarial and live end-to-end acceptance
issue.description: e2e-acceptance: exercise the combined unconditional path through disposable repositories and real SASE launches, repair every in-scope defect found, inspect finalizer artifacts and postconditions, and produce the evidence required for landing and closing sase-ro.

DISCOVERED ISSUE: At primary HEAD dc7da84f on 2026-08-21, external finalizer declaration payloads do not satisfy the protocol design: src/sase/finalizers/declaration.py:_validate_provider_payloads validates only builtin@commit and accepts any non-commit payload without invoking the selected provider's validate operation; src/sase/finalizers/executor.py:_provider_request passes config/selection but not the accepted payload or host obligations to describe/validate/execute/verify. Reproduction: inspect lines 750-777 of declaration.py and _provider_request in executor.py. Impact: declaration-driven external finalizers cannot validate or consume model input, despite every external provider currently forcing submission_required=true. This is causally owned by sase-rr's protocol completion/acceptance scope; no standalone task created.
